# pipx for CI's wheel-install job (.github/workflows/ci.yml), pinned with
# hashes: `pip install --require-hashes` refuses anything else (CI-1: no
# workflow runs an unpinned pip install). Dependabot (pip, /.github) proposes
# updates.
#
# Regenerate after changing the pin:
#   printf 'pipx\n' > /tmp/ci.in
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --universal --python-version 3.11 --no-header --no-annotate /tmp/ci.in -o .github/ci-requirements.txt
